title: Grokipedia vs Wikipedia: An LLM-Based Audit of Political Neutrality along Ideologies
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating political bias and ideological neutrality in encyclopedias (like Grokipedia and Wikipedia) rather than evaluating faith, religion, or ethics. It includes 'secular positioning' merely as one of nine political dimensions from the V-Party dataset, not as a core religious or ethical benchmark.
